## Run 6 — electron SdH spot check: raw, onset, and FFT

The D = 0 electron point uses run-5 region-A calibration: n = +3.20×10¹² cm⁻², B = 0→10 T. The code plots the measured four-terminal Rxx before background subtraction or FFT, then tests the onset and frequency stability against the low-field cutoff. This is a design read for the Landau fan, not yet a stacking verdict; the parallel region-B CNP ridge shifts local density by about +0.43×10¹² cm⁻².

from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
r6 = run(6)
print(summarize_run(r6))
B6 = r6.col('magnet_field')
I6 = r6.col('sr0_X') / -1e6
R6 = r6.col('sr1_X') / I6
print(f"T = {np.nanmin(r6.col('T_sample')):.3f}..{np.nanmax(r6.col('T_sample')):.3f} K; R = {np.nanmin(R6):.1f}..{np.nanmax(R6):.1f} ohm; I = {np.nanmin(I6)*1e9:.2f}..{np.nanmax(I6)*1e9:.2f} nA")
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 3)); plt.plot(B6, R6, lw=.8); plt.xlabel('B (T)'); plt.ylabel('raw Rxx (ohm)'); plt.title('run 6 — electron raw'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
on6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, r_full_scale=5000)
print(on6.summary())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
for lo in (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5):
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R6[:, None], B6, b_range=(lo, 10), log=False, nfft=4096)
    y = spec[0]
    peaks, _ = find_peaks(y, prominence=np.max(y)*.04)
    peaks = sorted((p for p in peaks if 2 < f[p] < 45), key=lambda p: y[p], reverse=True)[:5]
    print(f"B>{lo:.1f} T: " + ', '.join(f'{f[p]:.1f} T' for p in peaks))
    ax.plot(f, y/y.max(), label=f'B>{lo:.1f} T')
ax.set(xlim=(0, 45), xlabel='F (T)', ylabel='FFT / max', title='run 6 — cutoff stability'); ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## Run 7 — hole SdH spot check: raw, onset, and FFT

The D = 0 hole point is n = −1.20×10¹² cm⁻² at the negative TG limit, B = 10→0.3 T. The same raw-first read tests whether this side offers a cleaner FS-count measurement than the electron side. At this density the ABAB model predicts a close 5.3/7.1 T pair and the ABCA hole band is thermally heavy, so the read is intrinsically less decisive.

**Step-3 take (runs 6–7):** Both 1D sweeps completed with stable ~9.8–9.9 nA drain current, sample T 1.17–1.29 K, no sr1 rail (≤0.12 of 5 kΩ full scale), and gate-current medians at pA to ~0.1 nA. On the electron side the full low-B record has a ~7–8 T component and high-B windows retain a ~30 T component; the low-frequency onset algorithm reports 0.30 T but marks it *censored at the record edge*, so its physical onset and FFT stability are unresolved. Hole-side content around 5–7 T and ~12 T is strongly window-dependent and lies in the near-CNP model exception. The electron side is the fan target: high |n| separates the model's ABAB branches (~7.5/25.6 T at n=3.2) from an ABCA singleton (33.1 T), while the fan tests whether the observed components disperse as independent pockets or harmonics/mosaic contributions. No stacking call yet.

## HERA — Step 4: electron D = 0 Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:24** · landau-fan-vti: region-A D=0, electron n +2.40..+3.20e12 (22), B +0.8..+10 T (131 uniform 1/B), Si 0, sr1 50uV, 2.1s fast dwell; ends 10 T · **ETA ~08:54** (≈3h30m)

Run 5 calibrated the region-A D = 0 line and exposed a parallel region-B ridge (density offset ≈ +0.43×10¹² cm⁻²). Run 6 at n = +3.20×10¹² shows ~7–8 T low-frequency content and a ~30 T high-field feature, but their origin is ambiguous in one trace; run 7 is near the hole-side CNP and its peaks change with FFT window (ana cells 14–18). The governing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4 therefore calls for **one electron-side fan**: independent F(n) branches, their Luttinger sum, and the onset/field dependence can separate ABAB pockets, an ABCA singleton, harmonics, and possible series-mosaic contributions. No stacking assignment is made from either spot check alone.

The gate line has 22 points, n = +2.40→+3.20×10¹² cm⁻² (0.0381×10¹² step), corresponding to Vtg +0.7544→+0.9836 V and Vbg +0.8697→+1.1663 V. The field grid is 131 rows, +0.8→+10.0 T, uniform in 1/B. Run at Si 0 V, sr1 50 µV, fast_delay 2.1 s (7τ at 0.3 s/24 dB), slow_delay 1 s. The price includes the 0→0.8 T positioning and 0.8→10 T traverse, calibrated to run 5's 1.17 s/point at 1 s fast delay and runs 6–7's blocking magnet timing.

The high-frequency Nyquist target is F_L for region B at n ≈ 3.63×10¹², 37.5 T: Δ(1/B) = 0.00885 T⁻¹ gives ≥3 samples per cycle. At B = 0.8 T the fourfold LL density period is 0.0774×10¹² cm⁻²; the 0.0381 step gives ≥2 samples per ray. For the model's light ABAB pocket at n = 2.4 (≈4.8 T), the full 1/B span gives ≈5.5 periods (δF = 0.87 T), while the cleanest stacking claim will come from the upper-density columns. **Coverage trade:** the hole side and electron densities below +2.4 are excluded: the former lies in the near-CNP ABAB exception and thermally heavy ABCA regime, and the latter has fewer resolvable light-pocket periods and a higher high-B resistance risk. Including them would add gate points and weaken the fixed-sensitivity read. Run-6 Rmax = 530 Ω at n = 3.2 and run-7 Rmax = 587 Ω at n = −1.2; 50 µV at 10 nA gives 5 kΩ full scale, with headroom for the metallic n ≥ 2.4 line. Stop on >1 nA TG/BG leakage or ≥90% sr1 full scale.

Preflight: sample thermometry fresh and 1.0–1.5 K; vaporizer near base, heaters off; actual field near 0 T, Si = 0 V, PS heater on/output enabled; gate-current NPLC = 1; drive, τ and slope as recorded; validator values still equal the device card. Check the **first two landed rows** for actual B, rail/clipping, gate current, drain current, and live plots. Then check at ≈3 T and ≈6 T for emerging n-dispersing structure, leakage, rails, and whether the partial FFT remains worth the remaining field time. The magnet stays at +10 T for a possible measured ride-down; gates park at 0 V on cell completion or sweep interruption. Interrupting during a magnet set does not stop its in-flight ramp: read the actual field before any subsequent move.

# Electron-side D=0 Landau fan: tetralayer FS counting, cal from run 5.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
FAN_CAL = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)

# Assumed state (the cell does not set these): print expected vs actual before any move.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_hr = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print(f"preflight: T_sample {_T:.3f} K (1.0..1.5); T_vaporizer {_Tv:.3f} K (<1.5); "
      f"field {_B:+.4f} T (0 +/-0.05); Si {_Si:+.4f} V (0 +/-0.01); "
      f"heater ranges {_hr} (0,0); PS/output {_ps}/{_out} (True/True)")
print(f"preflight: TG/BG nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1); "
      f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V (1); sr0/sr1 tau {sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s (0.3/0.3); "
      f"slopes {sr0.filter_slope()}/{sr1.filter_slope()} (24/24); magnet settle {magnet.settle_s} s (>=3)")
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.5 and abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_Si) < 0.01
assert _hr == (0, 0) and _ps and _out
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 0.01
assert sr0.time_constant() == sr1.time_constant() == 0.3
assert sr0.filter_slope() == sr1.filter_slope() == 24 and magnet.settle_s >= 3
assert (k_tg.volt.vals.min_value, k_tg.volt.vals.max_value) == (-0.3, 1.0)
assert (k_bg.volt.vals.min_value, k_bg.volt.vals.max_value) == (-1.3, 2.0)
assert (dc205.smart_voltage.vals.min_value, dc205.smart_voltage.vals.max_value) == (-25.0, 25.0)
assert (magnet.field.vals.min_value, magnet.field.vals.max_value) == (-10.0, 10.0)
assert heater.sample_setpoint.vals.max_value == heater.vaporizer_setpoint.vals.max_value == 100.0

n_vec = np.linspace(2.4, 3.2, 22)  # 1e12 cm^-2; two samples/ray at B=0.8 T.
D_vec = np.zeros_like(n_vec)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, D_vec, FAN_CAL['c_tg'], FAN_CAL['c_bg'],
                                FAN_CAL['n_offset'], FAN_CAL['D_offset'])
B_vec = field_invB(0.8, 10.0, 131)  # uniform 1/B, ascending from present 0 T.
assert np.all((TG_MIN <= Vtgs) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((BG_MIN <= Vbgs) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
_ncheck, _Dcheck = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, FAN_CAL['c_tg'], FAN_CAL['c_bg'],
                           FAN_CAL['n_offset'], FAN_CAL['D_offset'])
assert np.max(np.abs(_ncheck - n_vec)) < 1e-8 and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck)) < 1e-8
print(f"grid: {len(B_vec)} B rows x {len(n_vec)} n; B {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, "
      f"delta(1/B)={abs(1/B_vec[1]-1/B_vec[0]):.6f} 1/T; "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}")

sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # fixed 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA; run-6 amplitude had <=0.11 FS.
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 1.0  # 7 tau at 24 dB/oct; field driver also settles 3 s.
I_TRIP, X_TRIP = 1e-9, 0.9 * sr1.sensitivity()
mc = dict(meas_config); mc['Si (V)'] = _Si; mc['sample_temperature:'] = _T
mc['comments'] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0 run-5 cal; n +2.40..+3.20e12 (22), "
                  f"B +0.8..+10 T (131 uniform-1/B), Si=0, sr1=50uV, fast_delay=2.1s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f"region A electron D=0 V/nm; n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (22); "
              f"B {B_vec[0]:+.2f}..{B_vec[-1]:+.1f} T (131 uniform-1/B); "
              f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; "
              f"Si=0, run-5 cal, sr1=50uV, fast_delay={FAST_DELAY}s")

# Gate line and leak preflight before the long field move.
try:
    s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
    interruptible_sleep(10)
    _Itg, _Ibg = k_tg.curr(), k_bg.curr()
    print(f"gate preflight: TG {k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, I {_Itg*1e12:+.1f} pA; "
          f"BG {k_bg.volt():+.4f} V, I {_Ibg*1e12:+.1f} pA; expect |I|<1 nA")
    assert abs(_Itg) < I_TRIP and abs(_Ibg) < I_TRIP
except BaseException:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
    raise

# Each fp channel gets a live trace. Row layout:
# [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P].
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, k_tg.curr); s.plot(k_bg.volt, k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, x1, temp = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[9])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP or x1 >= X_TRIP or not (1.0 <= temp <= 1.5):
        print(f"FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T nline Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A; |sr1_X|={x1:.3e} V; T={temp:.3f} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    magnet.field(B_vec[0])  # 0->0.8 T: ~6 min at 0.137 T/min; blocking + 3 s settle.
    print(f"field positioned: measured {magnet.field():+.4f} T, target {B_vec[0]:+.4f} T")
    assert abs(magnet.field() - B_vec[0]) < 0.02
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
    print(f"post fan: measured field {magnet.field():+.4f} T; gates TG {k_tg.volt():+.4f}, BG {k_bg.volt():+.4f} V")
